statement: Control -> DOM handler -> API route -> test coverage for every interactive control in static/index.html, plus the three UIV2-02 contract investigations. api_status is existing when every call the handler makes resolves to a mounted @app route, absent-route when a call matches no mounted route, unknown when the resolver left an edge open, no-api for handlers that never fetch, and no-handler for controls without an inline handler. The contracts distinguish existing / partial / absent / unknown and cite file evidence; the generator hard-fails if the sources drift from the classification, so --check is a gate.

chat_persona_registry.question: Is there a chat persona registry behind the picker?

picker.evidence: select#chatPersona at static/index.html:3759 ships no <option>; renderChatPersonaPicker() fills it from CHAT_PERSONAS on load and on every filter

registry.evidence: const CHAT_PERSONAS in the inline script with 3 persona(s): principal-engineer, bug-ux-auditor, code-only

council_session_deletion.question: Can a Council (hall) session be deleted or cleared through the API?

delete.evidence: DELETE /api/hall/sessions clears every session except those running a summon (clear_hall_sessions_db(exclude=running)); DELETE /api/hall/sessions/{id} removes one and answers 409 while its summon is in flight. Both are true deletes (archived: false) and touch no workspace file, because a hall session owns none.

mcp_credential_handling.question: How are MCP credentials stored and exposed?

storage.evidence: mcp_servers.auth_token column in the SQLite store, resolved through _keyring_read (keyring-backed)

api_surface.evidence: GET /api/mcp/servers answers with list_mcp_servers(include_secret=False); rows expose only has_token and masked_token (_mask_secret), never auth_token

ui_field.evidence: input#mcpToken is type="password" with placeholder "Optional for free servers"; blank keeps the stored value
